note: hero-idle-sheet.png contains 8 frames: frames 0 and 2-7 are the original breathing/shifting idle loop, stepped through by the CSS sprite animation in main.css (steps(frameCount - 1, end), i.e. steps(7, end) — not steps(frameCount, end) — so each step lands exactly on a frame boundary instead of a fractional offset). Frame 1 was replaced with a purpose-built closed-eyes composite (eyebrow/eye region only, taken from a user-supplied reference image and aligned/pasted onto a copy of frame 0) specifically for the blink effect in hero.js/.hero-sprite.blinking, since none of the original 8 frames isolated eye state on its own — they all varied across a broad breathing-shift region instead. The 'wander' behaviour in hero.js (walking toward/away from the venue) is a separate, additional idle behaviour layered on top of this frame animation.
